Keys                                    j/k scroll · esc or ? to close
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  navigation
  j/↓          next row
  k/↑          previous row
  g/home       first row
  G/end        last row
  ctrl+f/pgdn  page down
  ctrl+b/pgup  page up
  tab          next provider tab
  shift+tab    previous provider tab
  1-9          jump to tab (1 is All)
  /            filter
  esc          clear applied filter
  !            only rows needing action
  o            cycle sort: name, status, expiry
  z            fold or unfold the provider group
  :            command palette

  account
  enter   switch to selected account
  d/i     details
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
config ~/.config/gctx/config.json · log ~/.cache/gctx/tui-debug.log
